title: Biotech Firm Matrix Genetics Receives Investment From Avista Development
主要内容: Matrix Genetics, a biotechnology company focused on producing renewable fuels and specialty chemicals from cyanobacteria, received investment from Avista Development, Inc. The investment supports Matrix's spinout from Targeted Growth, an agricultural biotechnology firm. The funding enables Matrix to expand its labs and staff, and develop proprietary cyanobacteria strains capable of producing oil in significant quantities. The company aims to leverage biotechnology to enhance production characteristics and expand applications to fuels, chemicals, and other products. Avista Development recognized Matrix's potential in the energy sector and invested to support its development of lipid-based fuels and production strains suitable for different environments.
